title: Platelet membrane-coated alterbrassicene A nanoparticle inhibits calcification of the aortic valve by suppressing phosphorylation P65 NF-kappaB.
authors: Geng, Bingchuan; Chen, Xing; Chi, Jiangyang; Li, Fengli; Yim, Wai Yen; Wang, Kan; Li, Chenghao; Xie, Minghui; Zhu, Peng; Fan, Zhengfeng; Shi, Jiawei; Hu, Zhengxi; Zhang, Yonghui; Dong, Nianguo
one_liner_zh: 该文研究血小板膜包被的天然化合物ABA通过抑制P65磷酸化缓解主动脉瓣钙化，虽涉及NF-kappaB信号与分子对接，但核心是疾病治疗与湿实验，无蛋白质-DNA互作建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Rationale: Calcific aortic valve disease (CAVD) is a leading cause of cardiovascular mortality and morbidity with increasing prevalence and incidence. The pathobiology of CAVD involves valvular fibrocalcification, and osteogenic and fibrogenic activities are elevated in aortic valve interstitial cells (VICs) from diseased valves. It has been demonstrated that activated NF-kappaB pathway was present in the early stage of CAVD process. There is currently no effective clinical drugs targeting NF-kappaB pathway for CAVD treatment. Therefore, it is of great clinical significance to seek effective treatments for valve calcification. Methods: In this study, we established immortal human valve interstitial cells (im-hVICs) with pGMLV-SV40T-puro lentivirus. Alizarin red staining and western blotting were performed to evaluate the calcification of immortal VICs supplemented with different compounds. The natural fusicoccane diterpenoid alterbrassicene A (ABA) was found to have potential therapeutic functions. Ribonucleic acid sequencing was used to identify the potential target of ABA. Platelet membrane-coated nanoparticle of ABA (PNP-ABA) was fabricated and the IBIDI pump was used to evaluate the adhesion ability of PNP-ABA. Murine wire-induced aortic valve stenosis model was conducted for in vivo study of PNP-ABA. Results: The natural fusicoccane diterpenoid ABA was found to significantly reduce the calcification of human VICs during osteogenic induction via inhibiting the phosphorylation P65. Runt-related transcription factor 2 (Runx2) and bone morphogenetic protein-2 (BMP2) were down regulated with the treatment of ABA in human VICs. Additionally, molecular docking results revealed that ABA bound to RelA (P65) protein. Phosphorylation of P65 (Ser536) was alleviated by ABA treatment, as well as the nuclear translocation of P65 during osteogenic induction in human VICs. Alizarin red staining showed that ABA inhibited osteogenic differentiation of VICs in a dose-dependent manner. PNP-ABA attenuated aortic valve calcification in murine wire-induced aortic valve stenosis model in vivo. Conclusions: The establishment of im-hVICs provides a convenient cell line for the study of CAVD. Moreover, our current research highlights a novel natural compound, ABA, as a promising candidate to prevent the progression of CAVD.
abstract_zh: 理由：钙化性主动脉瓣疾病（CAVD）是心血管死亡和发病的主要原因，其患病率和发病率不断上升。CAVD的病理生物学涉及瓣膜纤维钙化，并且患病瓣膜的主动脉瓣间质细胞（VICs）中成骨和成纤维活性升高。已有研究表明，NF-kappaB通路的激活出现在CAVD过程的早期阶段。目前尚无针对NF-kappaB通路治疗CAVD的有效临床药物。因此，寻求瓣膜钙化的有效治疗方法具有重要的临床意义。方法：在本研究中，我们利用pGMLV-SV40T-puro慢病毒建立了永生化人瓣膜间质细胞（im-hVICs）。采用茜素红染色和蛋白质印迹法评估补充不同化合物的永生化VICs的钙化情况。发现天然fusicoccane二萜类化合物alterbrassicene A（ABA）具有潜在的治疗功能。利用核糖核酸测序鉴定ABA的潜在靶点。制备了血小板膜包被的ABA纳米颗粒（PNP-ABA），并使用IBIDI泵评估PNP-ABA的粘附能力。建立小鼠导丝诱导的主动脉瓣狭窄模型，用于PNP-ABA的体内研究。结果：发现天然fusicoccane二萜类化合物ABA通过抑制P65磷酸化，显著减少人VICs在成骨诱导过程中的钙化。在ABA处理的人VICs中，Runt相关转录因子2（Runx2）和骨形态发生蛋白-2（BMP2）表达下调。此外，分子对接结果显示ABA与RelA（P65）蛋白结合。ABA处理减轻了P65（Ser536）的磷酸化，以及人VICs成骨诱导过程中P65的核转位。茜素红染色显示，ABA以剂量依赖性方式抑制VICs的成骨分化。在体内，PNP-ABA减轻了小鼠导丝诱导的主动脉瓣狭窄模型中的主动脉瓣钙化。结论：im-hVICs的建立为CAVD研究提供了便捷的细胞系。此外，我们当前的研究强调了一种新型天然化合物ABA，作为预防CAVD进展的有前景的候选药物。
